summary: Frontend-only testing of Dressing Room (#/dressing-room) backstage rebuild. All 8 blocks verified: (T1) Desktop 1280x800 renders dressing-mirror with exactly 2 imgs (frame + dressing-mirror-avatar), dressing-cast has 7 avatar-pick-* buttons, dressing-rail renders 10 outfit-* cards for Charlie, nameplate shows 'Charlie'/'Classic', dressing-unlocked-count shows '19/31 outfits'. (T2) Clicking avatar-pick-finn then avatar-pick-stew leaves exactly 2 imgs in the mirror (no stacking), mirror-avatar src='assets/characters/stew.png', dressing-bubble shows "Stew! That's me! Hi!", localStorage jma_avatar_v1.character='stew'. (T3) outfit-disco click → avatar src='assets/characters/charlie-disco.png', card shows ON badge, nameplate 'Charlie/Disco', bubble "Ooh, lookin' good! Spin around!", jma_avatar_v1.outfit='disco', mirror still 2 imgs. (T4) outfit-punk (data-locked=true) → mirror avatar becomes charlie-punk.png with CSS filter 'grayscale(1) opacity(0.55) drop-shadow(...)', dressing-ghost-hint shows 'Earn it: Max the crowd in Shred City'; after 3.5s hint disappears, avatar reverts to charlie-disco.png, stored outfit unchanged. (T5) With jma_outfits_seen_v1='{}', outfit-disco and outfit-rundmc both have data-new=true and 'NEW!' label; clicking outfit-rundmc shows dressing-confetti, card becomes data-new=false, avatar wears charlie-rundmc.png, jma_outfits_seen_v1='{"charlie:rundmc":1}'. (T6) dressing-camera click triggers dressing-countdown (3→2→1, confirmed polaroid rendered), dressing-polaroid shows avatar img + caption 'Charlie · Classic'; polaroid-keep closes it, dressing-photo-wall has 1 img, jma_polaroids_v1 length=1, mirror still 2 imgs. (T7) Phone landscape 844x390: data-scale='1.00', bounding boxes for dressing-mirror, dressing-cast, dressing-rail, dressing-camera, dressing-nameplate all fit within viewport; outfit-disco tap works (avatar→charlie-disco.png). (T8) Back button navigates to #/sticker-book (verified via back-button data-testid). Plaza (#/home) campus-building-dressing-room kiosk present and clicking it loads the Dressing Room page (confirmed by screenshot). No stacking regression observed in any of the mirror flows.

issues: dressing-rail scrollLeft did not change when programmatically scrolled by 400px (scroll_before=0, scroll_after=0). Rail content may actually fit the 549px-wide rail container (no overflow), so swipe-to-reveal isn't exercised — items beyond are already in view or the content width equals container width. Verify that later outfits (Punk/Zoot Suit/etc.) are still reachable via swipe when there is overflow. All other elements fit within viewport.

critical_code_review_comments: Dressing Room implementation looks solid — no stacking regression (mirror always has exactly 2 imgs after character/outfit changes), locked try-on uses greyscale filter + 3s auto-revert correctly, gift-box flow updates jma_outfits_seen_v1 as expected, polaroid pipeline persists to jma_polaroids_v1.

Minor: Back button lands on #/sticker-book (confirmed) — intentional per spec. Plaza kiosk navigation works but Playwright page.url may report the old hash briefly immediately after the HashRouter transition; test harnesses should wait on data-testid of the destination page rather than page.url for faster assertion.
seed_data_creation: Per request: jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1', jma_avatar_v1={character:'charlie',outfit:'classic'}, jma_rank_seen_v1='soloist', jma_stickers_v1={ach_rhythm_cadet,ach_rhythm_pro,ach_ear_cadet}. For T5 only, jma_outfits_seen_v1='{}'; otherwise removed. jma_polaroids_v1 cleared before T6. Seeding was applied AFTER initial navigation to the origin, then page.reload() — critical, since setting localStorage on about:blank does not persist to the target origin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Important: when seeding localStorage for this app, you MUST goto() the origin first, then evaluate localStorage.setItem(...), then reload(). Otherwise PlayerNamePrompt (data-testid=player-name-prompt, z-index 150) blocks every click. Dressing Room testids verified: dressing-mirror, dressing-mirror-avatar (img count inside dressing-mirror == 2: frame + avatar), dressing-cast with avatar-pick-{charlie,finn,chunk,jazzy,stew,dr,lou}, dressing-rail with outfit-{classic,disco,surf,punk,zoot,...}, dressing-nameplate (inner text concatenates character + outfit, e.g. 'CharlieDisco'), dressing-unlocked-count, dressing-bubble, dressing-ghost-hint (locked try-on, 'Earn it: ...'), dressing-confetti (gift-box unwrap), dressing-camera, dressing-countdown, dressing-polaroid, dressing-polaroid-keep, dressing-photo-wall, back-button (goes to #/sticker-book), campus-building-dressing-room on #/home. Locked outfit try-on reverts after ~3s. Avatar mirror never stacks (fix verified).
